name: Peckham Rye Park Adventure Playground and Play Areas
description: Peckham Rye Park has an adventure playground, and GiGL lists play areas for under-7s and 7 to 13-year-olds. Toilets with baby changing are in the toilet blocks near Strakers Road and near the adventure playground, and the Round Café opens 8am to 6.30pm. The park also has Sexby Gardens, a Japanese garden, an arboretum and a skate park.
